manifest_row.title: Mercosur deal would 'make mockery' of EU climate strategy - ICSA

screening.main_topic: Opposition to the EU-Mercosur trade deal, especially its alleged conflict with EU climate policy and its effects on South American rainforests and Irish farmers.
screening.climate_relevance: The article repeatedly connects the proposed deal to the EU climate strategy, Ireland's climate action plan, and rainforest destruction, presenting the trade deal as undermining climate-related commitments.
screening.reason: Although the trade deal and Irish beef sector are the immediate focus, climate policy and environmental consequences are central to the article's argument against the deal, making this meaningful climate-change discourse.
